notes.title: 3/22 - Post GDC Patch Notes
notes.content:
We are back at it! (By we I mean Me, but including you!)

GDC was a great learning opportunity, and just like the last show I hope MQ becomes twice as awesome as a result. There was a lot of easy changes that I can grant right away, so this build is updated with the following tuning changes/additions. most of this is will be first trialed on the dagger than we will apply it to the other weapons.

- dagger is tuned to be slightly more snappy.
- dagger vfX added (needs work)
- no core mechanics use "stamina". only "dash" uses stamina. some weapons use stamina.
- contact hits* (currently only the dagger), the player will extend their hitbox to allow for contact hits loosening up the combat system in favor of the player
- two mystery rooms were added to the map. (proof of concept testing)

Immediate Roadmap:

New weapons are in the pipe, and I am going to redesign some of the lock and keys to be a bit more localized. (ie. players assume the red key is close to red lock).
The game begins a bit differently, there will be an optional tutorial level added as well.
Narrative lines have not been updated to reflect the story changes yet. They will be shortly.
More lines for the NPCs and Quests are coming soon.
More polish is needed, VFX and SFX/music will get some much needed attention.
Game/Level Design will undergo much more attention from a narrative lens.

THANK YOU TO EVERYONE I MET AT GDC! 

I am beyond exhausted and am continuing to recover, but the work has been cut out... and we are going to shape this game into something better, then repeat, until we have a great game. That's just how it goes. Thanks for playtesting, ETA for Demo release is May 1st.

notes.title: 1/10 Large Change to STA system
notes.content:
After reflecting on playtests I think the stamina system should be more discrete.

It now behaves a bit more inspired by Ori... and there is a new temporary meter at the bottom of the screen. The old meter is still in there but will go next build...

+ the user always can keep a mental count of stamina bars left now that its discrete
units of 1 are easier than "30" which i watched someone literally count down. this simplifies the mental math by at least one divide... the visual is simplified too.

+/- the system is slower, you have to wait a full unit to get to consume it... this makes me less happy now that ive had continuous... but i think a buff of like 2x regen rate would feel better. and once you have enough you wont really feel limited by it. unless we want to charge more for special moves... 

+ some other things, doors now only open inward. most pickups have a vfx attached to them to make them stand out even more.

- the spanish translation i think sucks. i dont know for sure because im not a speaker... but i can see the inconsistency in terms... i might have this professionally done closer to the demo release. 

+ another big change i want to implement is spawn ins and a small window for it. this way there are less surprises entering a room. this might be difficult to do across all npcs, ill probably have to touch as many as all of them... so we might just live with this complaint... which i take very seriously because it is indeed unfair to be dropped into battle. maybe its taggable for difficulty because its not entirely unreasonable to have the defenders have the upper hand... its just. not. fun. imho.

- i'm behind on polish and design because i wanted to fix other features... the demo probably will get pushed back hopefully not out of nextfest range... i might save nextfest for june and just still have the demo out around the same time if i cant get it polished up...

It's been an interesting year. Looking back at where the game started and how many times I thought the game would be good enough to show the world only to be humbled again and again. We are making so much progress right now and the game is really transforming right before my eyes.

The changes in this build are:

- You can now spend coin!! 
- All NPCs now hit a lot harder
- The intro to the chapel now has a new music track from Vilakshan!

Vilakshan has been gracious to allow me to use some of his music as we work towards a playable demo. This track is just a test placement, I think we want something else here, but holy smokes it is well executed guitar! Please support his music!!! http://www.youtube.com/@VilakshanKandwal

The next month will be furthering tuning of existing gameplay and upgrading the visual fidelity across the board, a lot of stuff is just in placeholder state and needs to move closer to something final. 

I personally believe the game needs to feel much more challenging than where it stands today, but I wanted people to be able to play through easily to the end. The game is quite fun when the difficulty is high.

Thanks again, hope you have a nice holiday season! Happy New Year! Development continues in 2025!

notes.title: Preview Demo 12/2 for 12/14 Expo!
notes.content:
Hello Friends,

Here is an early drop of the latest demo. Rather than continue on with the "first pancake".
We are cooking up a "second pancake". This is an entirely new environment with a lot of new updates.

- Dialogue NPCs now exist! Their actual dialogue still needs to be added and some new illustrations are on the way!
- Room to Room, movement and spawning. This leans heavily into classic Castlevania gameplay!
- Item looting is still changing from interactable drops to auto looting, again moving towards the classic.
- Fast travel and Save Rooms are on the way!

the current build is still a work in progress, the "boss" is just placeholder but it enjoys a new camera for boss encounters you can check out.
there are a few more NPCs I would like to add as well. And more gameplay mechanics to close the "main loop".

Our goal is to have the complete loop done in the next few days.

12/14 is when this demo will go live (Sac Game Expo), so play testing and feedback is desired! But also know that some of the more obvious stuff will be resolved in the next few days. 12/10 is probably the logical cut off.

I will finally be placing the narrative and some sound track choices into the game for the demo as well. It's hard for me to settle in on those choices, but I think they're solid and can't wait for you to check it out.

Lastly, there is a submission deadline for Gamescom Latam on the same date, so if I can do a localization pass I will also submit there.

Things will update very frequently for the next few days, so be aware; if its annoying you might want to turn off auto updates.

Thanks so much for your support! Things move fast and change often, we're still finding ourselves, but I am very proud of this iteration and hope you love it! 

- Brandon

PS there are some pre-caching hiccups/stutters on the first run of the game. still looking into viable solutions, but once you pre-cache once (running through the game once) it should not happen.

There will be a parry window where shields will cancel damage.
Block will be after the parry window and will mitigate damage on a scale.
It is based on length of button press. Currently, < 0.5 seconds is considered a parry.

-- Boss Room gets chandeliers!

There is now a place to stand and maybe even get some STA back. The wizard also takes his actions
within knife distance of the lamps. He generally stays a bit closer to the ground or on one of those two planes to make hitting him hopefully a bit easier.

A lot has changed, especially with the shields and xp leveling effecting stats... things do feel slightly more robust but i am sure bugs have been introduced as well. If you spot any please let me know!

Otherwise, I hope these changes are in the right direction and make the game a little better!

There is now a lot more incentive to kill everything and even grind out levels if you like that play style.  The system offers a lot more than it takes away and it was an easy decision to turn it on.

I don't think it really has that big of an effect other than it makes the endgame a little easier.
the bosses are still a little bit cheese so i will try to tune them further, again in short order...

Now, on a very casual play through you end up at the boss room with about 200 HP as opposed to 100 if you didn't find any heart containers. I left in all the heart containers, but I might change some to mana boosts or other goodies to be discovered.

We are aiming to be ready for a public playtest on 10/15 in anticipation of releasing the demo.

Thanks for play testing!!!
- Brandon
